judge_reports.reason: The reported break is that an empty range returns without loading a bitmap word, but with start equal to end there is no walk and no word to read, hasNext is false straight away, and the audited code and the reference repair return the same way, so requirements 4 to 6 hold.

summary: Sets currentTick to the aligned tick one step above the start's compressed position, using bit 0 of the next word when the start sits at bit 255, then calls _advanceToNextDown. The existing search therefore begins at the start tick's own bit.
